identificationModule.briefTitle: TACE Combined With Thermal Ablation and ADC, PD-1, and Chemotherapy as First-line Treatment for HER2-highly-expressing Gastric Cancer With Liver Metastases: A Multicenter, Single-arm Prospective Clinical Study.
identificationModule.officialTitle: TACE Combined With Thermal Ablation and Antibody-drug Conjugates, Immune Checkpoint Inhibitors, and Chemotherapy as First-line Treatment for HER2-highly-expressing Gastric Cancer With Liver Metastases: a Multicenter, Single-arm Prospective Clinical Study.

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study is a multicenter, single-arm prospective clinical trial designed to evaluate the efficacy of TACE combined with thermal ablation, antibody-drug conjugates, immune checkpoint inhibitors, and first-line chemotherapy for the treatment of HER2 - highly expressing gastric cancer with liver metastases.

armGroups.label: Interventional therapy + Chemotherapy + Targeted Therapy + Immunotherapy
interventionNames: Other: TACE combined with thermal ablation

interventions.name: TACE combined with thermal ablation
interventions.description:
The decision to perform transarterial chemoembolization (TACE) and/or thermal ablation is based on the blood supply, size, and number of liver metastases as determined by imaging examinations.

Interventional therapy is repeated every two cycles, and TACE and/or thermal ablation therapy are selected based on the blood supply, location, size and number of liver metastases.

secondaryOutcomes.description: Type, incidence, grading (based on NCI-CTCAE v5.0 criteria), and duration of adverse event

Through postoperative pathological examination, it was confirmed that all surgical margins (including peripheral margins, deep margins, circumferential margins, etc.) of the excised specimen did not show any residual tumor cells under the microscope, indicating a negative margin and complete resection of the tumor without visible tumor remnants under the naked eye or microscope.
